questions.q: How many lines of symmetry does a square have?
questions.explanation: A square has 2 diagonals, 1 vertical and 1 horizontal line of symmetry.

questions.q: How many lines of symmetry does an equilateral triangle have?
questions.explanation: There is one line from each vertex to the middle of the opposite side.

questions.q: Which letter has a vertical line of symmetry?
questions.explanation: Only A looks the same on both sides of a vertical line.

questions.q: How many lines of symmetry does a rectangle (that is not a square) have?
questions.explanation: One vertical and one horizontal line.

questions.q: How many lines of symmetry does a circle have?
questions.explanation: Every line through the centre is a line of symmetry.

questions.q: What is the order of rotational symmetry of an equilateral triangle?
questions.explanation: It looks the same after turns of 120°, 240° and 360°.
